about_the_game: You are Kellan Graves, a battle-hardened soldier from Echo-6. After a brutal fall into the depths of the alien world Elior, you find yourself trapped in a vast cave system, haunted by monstrous creatures and the remnants of a failed expedition. Armed only with your pistol and your resolve, you must fight, explore, and uncover the truth hidden in the shadows.
